# The news-and-markets pack

*News and markets* · version 1.0.0 · code `NWMK`

## What it is

A sample pack built on two on-demand connectors: fifteen news topics (central banks, countries, companies, themes) and twenty
well-known listed companies, each company with a live quote and price history (Yahoo Finance) and every topic and company with its
headlines (Google News). Internal demonstration only; off until its connectors are enabled. Offline, the demo lake serves a captured
snapshot.

## Data structures

Every kind the pack owns, read from its manifest, its samples and its Sutras: how its ids look, its fields (type, an example, what it means), its nested lists and the fields that link to other kinds. A path `A[].B` is field `B` of every element of list `A`.

### `news-topic`

**News topic** · mnemonic `TOPIC`.

**Id:** field `TOPIC_ID`; pattern `^TOPIC-`; for example `TOPIC-FED`.

Fields, from 15 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TOPIC_ID` | string | `TOPIC-FED` | The document's id |
| `NAME` | string | `Federal Reserve` | Topic |
| `CATEGORY` | string | `Central bank` | Category |
| `ALIASES` | list of strings |  | Other names the news connector searches for |
| `ALIAS_TEXT` | string | `Fed, FOMC, Powell` | Other names |
| `EDITION` | string | `default` | Edition |
| `NEWS_ID` | string | `NEWS-Federal_Reserve` | link to `news` |
| `NEWS_ALL_ID` | string | `NEWS-Federal_Reserve~all` | link to `news` |
| `ECONOMY` | string | `ECON-IND` | The topic's economy (world-economy pack) (in 33%) |

Links: `NEWS_ALL_ID` → `news`, `NEWS_ID` → `news`.

### `news`

**Headlines** · mnemonic `NEWS` · read through connector `news`.

**Id:** pattern `^NEWS-`.

No samples ship: documents are read live from its connector `news` (plugin `news`). The fields its screens show:

| Field | Shown as |
|---|---|
| `COUNT` | Headlines |
| `EDITION` | Edition |
| `ENTITY` | Entity |
| `FETCHED_AT` | Fetched |
| `RELEVANCE_FILTER` | Relevance filter |

### `listed-company`

**Listed company** · mnemonic `CO`.

**Id:** field `COMPANY_ID`; pattern `^CO-`; for example `CO-AAPL`.

Fields, from 20 sample documents:

| Field | Type | Example | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `COMPANY_ID` | string | `CO-AAPL` | The document's id |
| `TICKER` | string | `AAPL` | Ticker |
| `NAME` | string | `Apple Inc.` | Company name |
| `ALIASES` | list of strings |  | Other names the news connector searches for |
| `ALIAS_TEXT` | string | `Apple Inc, AAPL, iPhone` | Other names |
| `EXCHANGE` | string | `Nasdaq` | Exchange |
| `SECTOR` | string | `Technology` | Sector |
| `COUNTRY` | string | `US` | Country |
| `ECONOMY` | string | `ECON-USA` | Country economy (world-economy pack) |
| `QUOTE_ID` | string | `QUOTE-AAPL` | link to `quote` |
| `NEWS_ID` | string | `NEWS-Apple` | link to `news` |
| `NEWS_ALL_ID` | string | `NEWS-Apple~all` | link to `news` |

Links: `NEWS_ALL_ID` → `news`, `NEWS_ID` → `news`, `QUOTE_ID` → `quote`.

### `quote`

**Quote and price history** · mnemonic `QUOTE` · read through connector `yfinance`.

**Id:** pattern `^QUOTE-`.

No samples ship: documents are read live from its connector `yfinance` (plugin `yfinance`). The fields its screens show:

| Field | Shown as |
|---|---|
| `CHANGE` | Change |
| `CHANGE_PCT` | Change % |
| `CURRENCY` | Currency |
| `EXCHANGE` | Exchange |
| `MARKET_STATE` | Market |
| `PRICE` | Price |

| Sutra | Kind | What it shows |

| `listed-company` | `listed-company` | A listed company: its live quote and price history (yfinance connector) and its news headlines (news connector), both computed on demand. |
| `news-topic` | `news-topic` | A topic and the news about it: headlines (newest first) with their publishers and links, a count by source, and how the headlines were chosen. |
| `news` | `news` | The headlines for one name, as the news connector computed them: newest first, filtered for relevance, duplicates removed. |
| `quote` | `quote` | A quote and recent price history for a ticker, as the yfinance connector computed them. |

## Enabling and dependencies

Builds on no other pack.

A sample pack: Admin → Packs can hide it from business users (`drishti.packs.samples`).

The connectors it brings (written once to `config/connectors/<name>.yaml`, then the site's own):

| Connector | Plugin | Kinds | Enabled |
|---|---|---|---|
| `news` | `news` | `news` | `${DRISHTI_NEWS_ENABLED:false}` |
| `yfinance` | `yfinance` | `quote` | `${DRISHTI_YFINANCE_ENABLED:false}` |
| `news-store` | `delta` | `news-topic`, `listed-company`, `news`, `quote` | `${DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED:true}` |

Settings (environment variables) its connectors read: `DRISHTI_LAKE_ENABLED`, `DRISHTI_NEWS_ENABLED`, `DRISHTI_NEWS_URL`, `DRISHTI_YFINANCE_ENABLED`, `DRISHTI_YFINANCE_URL`.

## Refreshing the data

The topics and companies are written by `modules/news-and-events/packs/news-and-markets/tools/make_samples.py`; the offline snapshot by
`drishti.py feed run news-and-markets`.

The data feed `news-and-markets` (config/feeds/news-and-markets.yaml) pulls `quote`, `news`: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed run news-and-markets` fetches them daily into `data/datafeeds/news-and-markets/<date>/` and loads them into the lake `newslake` (internal use only); `--dry-run` says what it would fetch, changing nothing; `--snapshot` refreshes the committed snapshot in data/testdata instead; `feed status` shows the last runs. The External data feeds guide (docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md) has the schedule entries for Linux and Windows.

The pack's files are written by `tools/packgen/readme.py news-and-markets`; its `--check` fails when the committed files differ from what it would write.

## Data contracts

Every kind of the pack has a data contract: a YAML file beside the pack (`modules/news-and-events/packs/news-and-markets/contracts/<kind>.contract.yaml`, checked against `tools/contracts.schema.json`) that says what one record is, its key, how it is stored and dated, and every field with its type, presence, unit and meaning. The contracts are published on [docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md) and each kind's example (a real record of the test data, every field explained) on [docs/contracts/packs](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/README.md); this README links them and copies neither. Check them against the pack and its data with `python3 tools/contracts.py check` (or `drishti.py contract check`); show one with `python3 tools/contracts.py show <MNEMONIC>`.

| Command | Kind | Class | Key | Grain | Contract | Example |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TOPIC` | `news-topic` | fundamental | `TOPIC_ID` | One row per news topic, keyed by TOPIC_ID. | [TOPIC: News topic](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md#topic-news-topic-news-topic) (`contracts/news-topic.contract.yaml`) | [example](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md#example-news-and-markets-news-topic) |
| `NEWS` | `news` | fundamental | `NEWS_ID` | One row per headlines, keyed by NEWS_ID. | [NEWS: Headlines](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md#news-headlines-news) (`contracts/news.contract.yaml`) | [example](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md#example-news-and-markets-news) |
| `CO` | `listed-company` | fundamental | `COMPANY_ID` | One row per listed company, keyed by COMPANY_ID. | [CO: Listed company](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md#co-listed-company-listed-company) (`contracts/listed-company.contract.yaml`) | [example](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md#example-news-and-markets-listed-company) |
| `QUOTE` | `quote` | fundamental | `QUOTE_ID` | One row per quote and price history, keyed by QUOTE_ID. | [QUOTE: Quote and price history](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md#quote-quote-and-price-history-quote) (`contracts/quote.contract.yaml`) | [example](../../../../docs/contracts/packs/news-and-markets.md#example-news-and-markets-quote) |

*Class*: **fundamental** data is delivered by a source system and stored; **input** is stored data an engine reads; **computed** is worked out by Drishti when asked and never stored by a source; **drishti-owned** is kept by Drishti itself.

## Data retrieval

Where each kind's data comes from, how it reaches the lake and how to check it. Three origins: **external** data, fetched from a public source by its data feed (each source, its licence and worked examples on the [External data](../../../../docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md) help page); **synthetic** test data (or hand-written reference data), written by a generator with fictitious names; **computed** by a Drishti engine when it is asked, never stored by a source.

| Command | Kind | Origin | How it reaches Drishti |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TOPIC` | `news-topic` | hand-written reference data: `python3 modules/news-and-events/packs/news-and-markets/tools/make_samples.py` | `data/testdata/news-and-markets/news-topic/` → `lake demo` → connector `news-store` |
| `NEWS` | `news` | external: Google News RSS headlines (the news connector) (the headlines belong to their publishers; **internal only**) — refreshed by `drishti.py feed run news-and-markets` | `data/testdata/news-and-markets/news/` → `lake demo` → connector `news-store`; live through connector `news` (plugin `news`) when it is switched on (off as shipped) |
| `CO` | `listed-company` | hand-written reference data: `python3 modules/news-and-events/packs/news-and-markets/tools/make_samples.py` | `data/testdata/news-and-markets/listed-company/` → `lake demo` → connector `news-store` |
| `QUOTE` | `quote` | external: Yahoo Finance quotes and daily history (the yfinance connector) (Yahoo terms: personal use, no redistribution; **internal only**) — refreshed by `drishti.py feed run news-and-markets` | `data/testdata/news-and-markets/quote/` → `lake demo` → connector `news-store`; live through connector `yfinance` (plugin `yfinance`) when it is switched on (off as shipped) |

### External sources

| Source | Where | Licence | Internal only | Refresh |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Google News RSS headlines (the news connector) | https://news.google.com/rss | the headlines belong to their publishers | **yes** | `python3 tools/drishti.py feed run news-and-markets -- news` |
| Yahoo Finance quotes and daily history (the yfinance connector) | https://finance.yahoo.com | Yahoo terms: personal use, no redistribution | **yes** | `python3 tools/drishti.py feed run news-and-markets -- quote` |

**Internal only:** Google News RSS headlines (the news connector); Yahoo Finance quotes and daily history (the yfinance connector). The terms restrict reuse or forbid redistribution: the data is for internal demonstrations only, never written into a committed folder without `--internal-ok`, and must be raised with the owner before any client or external use.

Run these from the Drishti folder (the repository root, or the install folder of a release).

```bash
python3 tools/drishti.py feed status news-and-markets                                   # its last runs: last success, rows, failures (offline: the run ledger)
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run news-and-markets --dry-run                            # what would be fetched and loaded; changes nothing
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run news-and-markets                                      # pull today's data and load it into the lake `newslake` (what the daily schedule runs)
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run news-and-markets --set server=http://localhost:18480  # through a running server's live connectors instead of a scratch server
python3 tools/drishti.py feed run news-and-markets --snapshot --internal-ok             # replace the committed snapshot in data/testdata instead (internal demos only), then lake demo
```

The same with the Python you run Drishti with: `python3 tools/drishti.py feed run news-and-markets` on Linux and macOS, `py tools\drishti.py feed run news-and-markets` on Windows (every argument is passed on); the daily schedule entries: `drishti.py feed schedule --cron` (or `--systemd`, `--windows`) ([WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md](../../../../docs/guides/WORLD_DATA_GUIDE.md)).

### Generators

| Generator | Writes | Check |
|---|---|---|
| `python3 modules/news-and-events/packs/news-and-markets/tools/make_samples.py` | hand-written reference data (topics and listed companies) into the pack's samples/ | — |

### Into the lake, checking, offline

- **The lake.** `python3 tools/drishti.py lake demo` reads `data/testdata/testdata.yaml` and writes every dataset (test data, the committed public-data snapshots) into `<data>/delta/<domain>/<kind>/`, where the pack's Delta connector serves it; a computed kind needs nothing loaded. `lake build` loads your own large JSON exports the same way ([Command line](../../../../docs/guides/CLI_REFERENCE.md)).
- **Checking.** `python3 tools/contracts.py check` compares every contract with the pack and its data; each generator's `--check` (above) fails when the committed files differ from what it would write; in the console, `<MNEMONIC> <GO>` lists a kind and the pack's code opens its overview with the count of each kind.
- **Offline.** Everything committed works without a network: the test data and the public-data snapshots are in the repository and `lake demo` reads only them. A data feed runs offline from its download cache (`--offline`); a connector that reaches the internet (news, yfinance, the public-data feeds) is off as shipped and never starts on a machine configured offline (`drishti.offline.plugins`).
